summary: Implemented the issue #201 refactor without running any code or committing. New level-1 modules: monai/data/nifti_saver.py (NiftiSaver) and monai/data/csv_saver.py (CSVSaver), plus plot_2d_or_3d_image in monai/visualize/img2tensorboard.py. SegmentationSaver, ClassificationSaver and TensorBoardImageHandler now delegate to these while keeping their public constructors. Docs updated in docs/source/data.rst. Added four unit test files: test_nifti_saver.py, test_csv_saver.py, test_plot_2d_or_3d_image.py, test_handler_segmentation_saver.py. Tests are unverified because I was not allowed to run them. Known preserved bug: the 3-channel non-RGB branch of plot_2d_or_3d_image returns after the first channel. ClassificationSaver's private attributes moved to self.saver.
